name: Apefolk
body:
Apefolk are very reclusive and are often assumed by other humanoids to be quite primitive. However, it is a mistake to underestimate them, for they are quite intelligent and their hidden settlements are the very image of sophistication.

Physical

Apefolk bear a strong resemblance to gorillas. They have dark coloration in their skin, hair and eyes, although males develop patches of gray hair on their backs as they mature. They walk on two legs, although they can drop to all fours when they need to move quickly.

Males usually stand 5-1/2 to 6 feet tall and weigh 300 to 400 pounds, while females are a foot shorter and weigh half as much. All ape-folk have extremely long arms for their body size, with the arm span of the largest males reaching upwards of 8-1/2 feet.

Social

Along with such strong physical dimorphism, apefolk also tend to display strong social segmentation in the duties of the sexes. The females among them are typically responsible for the spiritual leadership of the community, and for making laws that affect interactions within the tribe.

The males of an apefolk community, on the other hand, are traditionally responsible for its defense. They do the hunting, wage the wars, and form political alliances outside of the tribe.

Despite this strict separation, both genders are seen as equally important and enjoy equal rights under long-standing laws and customs.

Apefolk build large villages and towns in the jungle, which are well-defended and hidden from approach. Nevertheless, these communities are thriving cultural centers, with an emphasis on crafts, schools, and fair trade.

Alignment and Religion

Apefolk are varied in their outlook, but many gravitate to a centered, pragmatic worldview and thus trend toward Neutral alignments. More have a tendency for Good than Evil, although the reverse seems to be true concerning those individuals that display a talent for psionics.

Traditionally, apefolk have practiced a form of animism, worshiping various nature and ancestral spirits, led by a tribal shaman or druid. However, many tribes also venerate a smattering of “higher spirits,” usually lesser deities covering specific areas of concern to their community. Thus one tribe may add a god of weather to the list of “spirits” it observes, while another may worship a god of the forest.

Traits
Ability Score Modifiers Apefolk are a sexually dimorphic species. If you are female, you gain +2 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Wis. If you are male, you gain +4 Str, +2 Dex. [flexible, Advanced Str] (6)
Size Medium. As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. (0)
Type Humanoid. You are a Humanoid with the apefolk subtype. (0)
Speed Varied. Your base movement rate is 20 feet. Your speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance. If your hands are free, you can drop down to all fours and move at a rate of 30 feet. You gain a +4 bonus to your CMD against trip attacks while on all fours, but you do not gain the increased carrying capacity of a quadruped. You can charge on all fours, then rear up to attack with natural weaponry at the end of the charge. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Ko’olar. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Catfolk, Draconic, Elven, Giant, Shisk, and Sylvan. (0)
Other Species Traits
Climb You have a climb speed of 20 feet, and gain the +8 species bonus on Climb checks that a climb speed normally grants. (2)
Senses Low-light vision. You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions. (1)
Natural Armor Your tough hide provides you with a +1 natural armor bonus. (2)
Natural Weaponry You have a bite attack and two claw attacks. These are all primary natural weapons that deal 1d4 damage each. (4)
Dimorphic Male and female apefolk typically display discernible differences in size and temperament. They have differing abilities based on this notable sexual dimorphism, as follows. (5)
Female: As the spiritual leaders and guides of the apefolk community, ape-women are especially in tune with the world around them, as well as the history and lore of the greater universe. As an ape-woman, you gain a +2 species bonus to all checks with Knowledge (nature) and any one other Knowledge skill of your choice. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on Perception checks made to avoid being surprised by an opponent.
Male: Because of their long arms, powerful grip strength, and massive builds, ape-men have assumed a guardian role within the apefolk community. You gain Lunge as a bonus feat and the powerful build ability. Powerful build allows you to function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Whenever you are subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a CMB or CMD, you are treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to you. You are also considered to be one size larger when determining the damage of your unarmed strikes, and when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size can affect you. You can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty. However, your space and reach remain those of a creature of your actual size. The benefits of this ancestry trait stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change your size category.
Total: 20 RP (monstrous)
Alternate Species Trait

Dysphoric Your gender characteristics do not conform to your biological sex. If you are female, you gain the species traits of a male apefolk; if you are male, you gain the species traits of a female apefolk. This trait alters ability score modifiers and dimorphic.

Special: This trait can stack with the psionic variant shown below.

Variants
Psionic Apefolk

Some apefolk display a surprising knack for developing powers of the mind.

The following traits alter ability score modifiers and replace dimorphic.

Ability Score Modifiers If you are female, you gain +2 Str, +2 Int, +2 Wis. If you are male, you gain +2 Str, +2 Int, +2 Cha.
Apefolk Psionics Once per day, you can use mind thrust as a psi-like ability. If you are female, you can also use call to mind once per day as a psi-like ability, while if you are male, you can use demoralize once per day as a psi-like ability. The manifester level for these effect is equal to 1/2 your character level (minimum 1), and you can choose either Charisma or Wisdom as your manifesting ability.
Naturally Psionic You gain Wild Talent as a bonus feat at 1st level. If you take levels in a psionic class, you instead gain the Psionic Talent feat.
Psionic Aptitude When you take a level in a favored class, you can choose to gain an additional power point instead of a hit point or skill point.
Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Add +1 to your total number of rage rounds per day.
Brawler Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.
Druid Add +1/3 to your natural armor bonus when using wild shape.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.
Mesmerist Increase painful stare’s damage by +1/4 point.
Monk Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.
Oracle Add +1/2 to your oracle level for the purpose of determining the effects of your curse class feature.
Psion Add +1/2 to concentration checks when manifesting psion powers.
Psychic Warrior Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.
Ranger Add +1 hit point to your animal companion. If you ever replace your animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Shaman Add one spell from the druid spell list that isn’t on the shaman spell list to the list of shaman spells you know. This spell must be at least one spell level lower than the highest-level shaman spell you can cast.
Shifter Add a +1/3 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls when using shifter claws (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Spirit Warrior Add +1 to your total number of rounds per day that you can use your aura ability.
Witch Add one spell from the witch spell list to your familiar. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level witch spell you can cast. If you ever replace your familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
